messages.content: What is the current time in New York City?

function.name: weather_forecast_get
function.description: Retrieve the current weather forecast for a specific location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location you want to retrieve the weather for.

hour.description: The hour of the day in 24-hour format (optional). If not provided, the current hour will be used. Default: 24

message.content: I’m sorry, but I don’t have real‑time access to the current clock. If you need the exact time right now, you can check a reliable world‑clock website or your device’s clock set to the New York time zone (UTC‑5 during standard time, UTC‑4 during daylight saving time).
message.reasoning: The user asks: "What is the current time in New York City?" We need to provide the current time. We don't have real-time data. We can approximate or say we can't fetch real-time. But maybe we can use the weather_forecast_get function to get the current hour? That function returns weather forecast, not time. There's no function to get time. So we should respond that we cannot fetch real-time. We can provide approximate time based on UTC offset. But we don't know current UTC. We could say "I don't have real-time capability." So answer: I can't provide current time.
